recorded_discrepancies.detail: scope v0 serializes `attendance` only beside the modern `future=hearing` spelling; the legacy inbound `status=hearings` spelling drops it. The project population is identical either way, so this is a selector discrepancy, not a parity failure.

The Land surface has no `closing` route key, so a hearings closing-this-week selection does not survive canonical serialization. Pre-existing; recorded rather than changed, because altering it would change Land URL semantics beyond this card.
